profile.org_note: Small contractor organisation, not segments and divisions: CEO Matthew Bette (owner family, based with the group in Latham, NY), President Mark Lear and COO Ron Rollins in Plano, and a Southeast office in Tampa under Vice President Patrick Bette and Director John Jones. There is no land acquisition, land development or finance officer published; land decisions sit with its developer clients, and group finance appears to run from the Bette Companies office in Latham.
profile.summary: Not a conventional for-sale homebuilder. BBL Building Company (legal entity BBLBC, LLC) is a family-owned general contractor that builds build-to-rent communities, apartments and commercial buildings for developers on the developers' land; its Builder 100 closings are rental homes delivered to clients such as NexMetro (Avilla), Advenir Oakley (LEO), Coastal Ridge (Stillwell), Urban Moment (Yardhomes), Red River Development and Marquesa Capital Partners. Pro Builder ranks it third in built-to-rent for 2025 with about $335.8M of revenue or value and 1,560 units; the company cites 8,000+ BTR units in 40+ communities. It is part of the Bette Companies of Latham, NY (Bette & Cring, BC Energy, First Columbia) and is not the separate Albany firm BBL Construction Services. It owns and options no lots that are public, so it is not a plausible direct land-banking customer; its value to a land banker is as a route to the BTR developers it builds for.
